meta.title: Event parking — MEGA Parking Piraeus
meta.description: Reserve a set number of parking spaces for your event, steps from Piraeus port. Guaranteed spaces, one agreed price, no surprises.

hero.title: Your guests shouldn't have to hunt for a space
hero.subtitle: We hold the exact number of spaces you need, for the hours you need them.
hero.body: A wedding, a corporate launch, a concert, a cruise arrival. Whatever you are hosting, the first thing guests remember is how easily they arrived — and the last thing, how easily they left.
hero.note: We reply within one business day. Asking costs nothing.

benefits.title: Space that is held, not hoped for
benefits.description: A booking is not a promise that there will probably be room. The spaces are taken out of general circulation and kept waiting for you.

reserved.title: Exclusive spaces
reserved.description: The agreed number is blocked off and marked before your first guest arrives.

price.title: One price, known in advance
price.description: You agree the total in the quote. Your guests pay nothing on the way out.

access.title: A person welcomes you
access.description: There is always staff at the entrance to direct vehicles to the reserved bays. The plate is recorded automatically, with no tickets to keep.

staff.title: Staff on site
staff.description: For large arrivals, a member of our team directs vehicles to the reserved bays.

security.title: Guarded facility
security.description: Cameras at the entrance, the exit and on every level, around the clock.

invoice.title: A single invoice
invoice.description: One invoice at the end, in your company name — not dozens of receipts.

step1.title: Send the request
step1.description: Date, hours and number of spaces. Two minutes, from the form on this page.

step2.title: Receive a quote
step2.description: We check availability and reply within one business day with a total price.

step3.title: The spaces are held
step3.description: Once you confirm, the space is locked in your name for the hours you set.

cases.title: Every arrival that cannot afford a delay

q1.q: How far in advance should I book?
q1.a: The earlier the better, but we accept requests for the next day when there is availability. For more than 40 spaces, a week ahead is safer.

q2.q: What if fewer cars turn up?
q2.a: You are charged for the spaces you reserved, because those were withdrawn from general use. That is why we agree a realistic number with you before confirming.

q3.q: What if I need more spaces at the last minute?
q3.a: Call us. If there is room we will add it — we simply cannot guarantee it without notice.

q4.q: Do guests pay on the way out?
q4.a: No. The cost is agreed in advance and invoiced to you. Your guests simply drive away.

q5.a: Yes. Mention it in the notes of your request and we will reserve spaces close to the pedestrian exit.

cta.title: Tell us how many spaces, and when
cta.description: Fill in the form and you will have a quote within one business day. We will send you a copy of your request as well.

form.title: Event request
form.description: Give us the essentials. Sending this commits you to nothing.
form.name: Full name
form.notesPlaceholder: Coaches, accessible parking, guest arrival time…
form.consent: I agree that my details may be used to answer this request.
form.successBody: We have emailed you a copy. We will be in touch within one business day.
form.overnightHint: The end time is earlier than the start time — we will treat the event as running past midnight.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.
